Paragraph: O chastiser of the enemy, the sacrifice of knowledge is greater than the sacrifice of material possessions. O son of Prtha, after all, the sacrifice of work culminates in transcendental knowledge.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Overvaluing physical/material sacrifices while neglecting the cultivation of wisdom and understanding.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'O chastiser of the enemy, the sacrifice of knowledge is greater than the sacrifice of material possessions. O son of Prtha, after all, the sacrifice of work culminates in transcendental knowledge.'
Outcome/Resolution: Physical actions and material sacrifices reach their complete fulfillment when they lead to wisdom and self-realization.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Priority of Wisdom: Valuing mental clarity and self-knowledge above material accumulations
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Cognitive Elevation: Transforming outer habits into internal psychological growth
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Purposeful Action: Ensuring routine actions serve the ultimate goal of wisdom

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Sreyan dravya-mayad yajnat jnana-yajnaj (Sacrifice of knowledge is superior to material offerings)
Sarvam karmahkilam partha jnane parisamapyate (All work culminates in transcendental knowledge)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The pursuit of divine wisdom surpasses material charity, as all work finds its true completion in transcendental knowledge.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: External efforts gain true psychological value only when they yield deeper self-awareness and mental clarity.
